1. (Currently Amended) A method for content optimization, comprising: receiving a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the rule on probability factor, wherein the plurality of pieces of content are generated by a processor executing computer-implemented instructions to automatically vary the selected content attribute across the plurality of pieces of content according to the rule on probability factor; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use, wherein the content performance data includes measurable user engagement metrics specific to each piece of content; determining, by a processor, an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated performance data, wherein the modification comprises adjusting the statistical probability to increase the likelihood of generating future content with attribute values that correlate with improved performance metrics.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a size or position adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein each attribute is computationally manipulated by the processor to generate distinct content variations.

5. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein the deviation value represents statistical variance in performance across the plurality of pieces of content.

6. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a set of rules for content generation; identifying a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation; and composing, by the processor, one or more rules on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, wherein the composing step comprises automatically generating initial probability distributions through algorithmic analysis of the set of rules.

8. (Currently Amended) A content optimization system, comprising: a rule management module maintaining a set of rules for content generation, the set of rules comprising a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; a content generation module operative to generate a plurality of pieces of content based on the set of rules, the plurality of pieces of content designed with a particular optimization objective, wherein the content generation module automatically varies the selected content attribute across the plurality of pieces of content according to the rule on probability factor; and a content evaluation module operative to evaluate content performance on reaching the particular optimization objective based on data acquired when the plurality of pieces of content are displayed, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the evaluated content performance, wherein the rule management module is operative to amend the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated content performance data, and wherein the amendment comprises adjusting the statistical probability to increase the likelihood of generating future content with attribute values that correlate with improved performance metrics.

9. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein each attribute is computationally manipulated by the content generation module to generate distinct content variations.

10. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, and wherein the rule management module is further operative to modify the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein the deviation value represents statistical variance in performance across the plurality of pieces of content.

11. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the rule management module is further operative to identify a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation and compose a rule on probability factor for the changeable content attribute, wherein the composing comprises automatically generating initial probability distributions through algorithmic analysis of the set of rules.

13. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: receiving a first rule on probability factor and a second rule on probability factor, the first rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a first value of a selected content attribute, the second rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a second value of the selected content attribute, the second value being different from the first value; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor, wherein the plurality of pieces of content are generated by a processor executing computer-implemented instructions to automatically vary the selected content attribute across the plurality of pieces of content according to the first and second rules on probability factor; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use, wherein the content performance data includes measurable user engagement metrics specific to each piece of content; determining, by a processor, a first aggregated performance data for the first value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; determining, by the processor, a second aggregated performance data for the second value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content; and modifying, by the processor, the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the second aggregated performance data, wherein the modification comprises adjusting the statistical probabilities to increase the likelihood of generating future content with attribute values that correlate with improved performance metrics.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition, and wherein each attribute is computationally manipulated by the processor to generate distinct content variations.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the first rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute, and wherein the deviation value represents statistical variance in performance across the plurality of pieces of content.
